summary.content:
Today's selection covers 70 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 39 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Art schools are being torn apart by AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: CrewAI Vulnerabilities Expose Devices to Hacking
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, NY Times Tech, TechCrunch, SecurityWeek, BleepingComputer and others
• **Fresh Content**: 41 articles published in the last 24 hours
